query:
SELECT c.id, c.name, c.corporationId, COUNT(ccr.contactId) as contact_count 
FROM companies c 
INNER JOIN contact_company_relations ccr ON ccr.companyId = c.id 
WHERE c.name LIKE '%Robert Bosch%Deutschland%' 
GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.corporationId
